notes:
Lead: VP Product (Simone Dubois) is the champion for in-product AI features. Team is mid-market SaaS (customer onboarding, help center, search) exploring Hosted API first to get product-market fit, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and EU-only residency. Key themes from calls: 
- Strong requirement: EU-only logs + audit trail for contracts in Germany/France. "We cannot have PII leave EU boundaries" (Simone).
- Latency target: p95 < 150ms for in-app assistant in EU; willing to accept higher latency for failover when routing to non-EU.
- Throughput: average 20 req/s with spikes to 80 req/s during peak onboarding flows. Cost-sensitive: looking to minimize per-token cost on high-volume rerank and embeddings jobs.
- Preference: start with Redwood Hosted API (EU region) to validate prompts and behavioral metrics, then evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity for the onboarding flows where latency variability is unacceptable.
- Security: needs SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retention 2+ years, and contract clause for data residency.
- POC ask: 2-week Dedicated POC in eu-west with telemetry (token-level cost, p95/p99 latency, failover counts) and a simple canary routing policy between eu and global nodes.
- Quote from engineering lead: "If we can guarantee EU-only storage and a straightforward failover policy, we can justify the Dedicated commit".
- Pricing: requested 3 pricing scenarios (hosted-only, hosted->dedicated hybrid, dedicated-12mo commit). Looking for ARR + cost-per-concurrent-session estimates.
- Misc: legal requested sample DPA + SOC2 attestation. SE provided security FAQ link; legal opened INFRA-4127 for clarifications.
